reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Modern Education
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing education by personalizing learning experiences for individual students. AI-powered systems can analyze student performance data and adapt teaching methods in real-time, helping struggling learners catch up while allowing advanced students to progress faster. Moreover, AI tutoring systems are available 24/7, providing instant feedback and reducing the burden on teachers. However, concerns about data privacy and over-reliance on technology remain significant challenges that educators must address carefully.

questions.q: What is one advantage of AI-powered systems in education?
options: A) They completely replace traditional teachers
B) They can personalize learning and provide real-time adaptation
C) They eliminate the need for student motivation
D) They guarantee all students will excel
questions.explanation: 지문에서 AI 시스템이 학생의 성과를 분석하고 교수 방법을 실시간으로 조정할 수 있다고 명시되어 있습니다. 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is a significant concern about AI in education?
options: A) It costs too much money
B) It makes learning too easy
C) Data privacy and over-reliance on technology
D) It works only for advanced students
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 'concerns about data privacy and over-reliance on technology'이 중요한 과제라고 언급되어 있습니다. 정답은 C입니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about AI tutoring systems?
options: A) They are only available during school hours
B) They provide continuous support without time limitations
C) They cannot provide feedback to students
D) They are too complicated for teachers to use
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'AI tutoring systems are available 24/7, providing instant feedback'이라고 명확히 표시되어 있습니다. 정답은 B입니다.

writing.prompt: Some people believe that online learning is superior to traditional classroom learning. Do you agree or disagree with this statement?

structure.intro: 도입부에서는 온라인 학습과 전통적 교실 학습에 대한 명확한 입장을 제시하고, 주요 이유 2-3가지를 간단히 소개합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 본론: 온라인 학습의 장점(유연성, 접근성) 또는 단점(사회적 상호작용 부족)을 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명합니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 본론: 전통적 교실 학습의 가치(직접 상호작용, 즉시 피드백) 또는 제한점(시간/공간 제약)을 논의합니다.
structure.conclusion: 결론부에서는 두 학습 방식의 보완적 역할을 인정하면서 자신의 최종 입장을 재확인합니다.

useful_phrases: In my opinion, I believe that...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer studying alone in a quiet environment. Others prefer studying in groups with peers. Which study method do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: Personally, I prefer studying in groups because...
One reason is that group study helps me...
Furthermore, when studying with others, I can...
In contrast, studying alone allows me to...
Overall, I believe that... is more beneficial because...
sample_points: 그룹 스터디는 다양한 관점을 배울 수 있고, 어려운 부분을 함께 해결할 수 있는 장점이 있습니다.
혼자 공부하면 자신의 속도대로 집중할 수 있고, 방해 없이 깊이 있는 학습이 가능합니다.

listening.title: Student Advising Session
listening.script: Student: Hi Professor, I'm struggling with my course load this semester. I'm taking five classes and working part-time, and I'm running out of time. Advisor: I see. Let's look at your schedule. It sounds like you're overcommitted. Have you considered reducing your course load? Student: I'm worried about falling behind in my degree program. Advisor: That's understandable, but your academic performance is more important than speed. Many students find that taking four classes allows them to maintain better grades and actually makes progress more meaningful. Additionally, you could adjust your work schedule or look for campus jobs that are more flexible with student schedules. Student: That makes sense. What about online classes? Could those help? Advisor: Yes, online classes can be flexible, but they still require the same amount of work. The key is balancing quality learning with your personal capacity. Would you like to meet again next week to plan your next semester?

questions.q: What is the main problem the student is facing?
options: A) Poor grades in all classes
B) Overcommitment with five classes and part-time work
C) Lack of interest in their major
D) Inability to find campus resources
questions.explanation: 학생이 5개의 수업과 파트타임 일을 하고 있으며 시간이 부족하다고 언급했습니다. 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: What solution does the advisor primarily suggest?
options: A) Transfer to a different university
B) Drop out of work completely
C) Reduce the course load to maintain better academic performance
D) Take only online classes
questions.explanation: 교수는 학생에게 수강 과목을 줄이면 더 나은 성적을 유지할 수 있다고 제안합니다. 정답은 C입니다.

questions.q: What does the advisor say about online classes?
options: A) They are easier than traditional classes
B) They require the same amount of work despite being flexible
C) They are the best solution for all students
D) They don't count toward the degree
questions.explanation: 교수는 온라인 수업이 유연하지만 같은 양의 노력이 필요하다고 설명합니다. 정답은 B입니다.
